WIN2\SESSION\189RS 134
Water scarcity in Secunderabad
Cantonment Board area
*441. SHRI K. KALAVENKATA
RAO:
DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
severe water crisis in the Secunderabad
Cantonment Board area;
(b) if so, the reasons for irregularities in
water supply in the Cantonment area; and
(c) the action proposed to solve the water
problem there?
Task Force for development of barren
land
†*442. SHRI RAJIV RANJAN SINGH
'LALAN':
SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
constituted any Task Force for the
development of barren land in the country;
(b) if so,when this Task Force was
constituted, the names of its members and
their qualifications in the field of land
reforms; and
(c) by when, this Task Force has been
asked to submit its recommendations?
Delegations/NHRC's visit to Gujarat
*443. SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
SHRI BHAGATRAM
MANHAR:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a large number
of teams/delegations and Ministers have
visited the various parts of Gujarat to make
on-the-spot assessment of damage during
the recent riots;
(b) whether the National Human Rights
Commission (NHRC) have also visited the
State;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) what are the details of reports
submitted by each group; and
(e) what is the reaction of Government
on the reports submitted by those groups/
delegations?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

WIN2\SESSION\237RS 135
Meetings of Inter-State Council
*444. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of meetings Inter-State
Council held during the last year;
(b) the subjects which were discussed
and the recommendations made;
(c) the details of recommendations which
are yet to be implemented;
(d) if so, by when those recom-
mendations will be implemented; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Unemployed persons in rural areas
†*445.SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
SHRI RAJIV RANJAN SINGH
'LALAN':
 Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have made any
estimate of the unemployed persons in the
rural areas of the country;
(b) if so, what was their number at the
end of Ninth Five Year Plan; and
(c) the time-frame fixed by Government
to provide job to each of them?
Implementation of the
recommendations of Expenditure
Reform Commission
†*446. SHRI MUNAVVAR HASAN:
Will the Minister of COAL AND MINES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether his Ministry has constituted
an Expenditure Reform Commission to
give recommendations with regard  to
reducing extravagance in his Min istry/
Departments;
(b) if so, the recommendations made by
the Commission so far;
(c) the details of recommendations yet
to be implemented by his Ministry/
Departments and reasons for not
implementing the same till date; and
(d) by when the same are likely to be
implemented?
Power projects in Rajasthan
*447. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased to
state:
(a) how many power projects have been
executed in the State of Rajasthan during
the last three years;
(b) the financial and other details thereof;
(c) what is the capacity of each of these
power projects; and
(d) by when they are likely to start
commercial production?
BPL in rural areas
†*448.SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAJIV RANJAN SINGH
'LALAN':
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the number of
persons living below the poverty line in the
rural areas has not been reduced in 90s as
per targets because of lack of the availability
of employment opportunities;
(b) if so, what is Government's
assessment in this regard; and
(c) the number of persons living below
the poverty line in the rural areas at the end
of Ninth Five Year Plan?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

136
WIN2\SESSION\237RS 136
Funds for accelerating power reforms
*449. SHRI RUMANDLA RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH: Will the Minister of
POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Finance Ministry is
considering to provide more funds for
accelerating power reforms in the States;
(b) if so, whether this will be in addition
to the budget provisions of Rs. 4,000 crore
sought by his Ministry;
(c) whether these funds will be invested
in the States under the new Accelerated
Power Development and Reforms
Programme; and
(d) if so, to what extent the new
programme will help in meeting demands
of the States?
Power generation from non-
conventional energy sources
*450. SHRI K.M. KHAN: Will the
Minister of NON-CONVENTIONAL
ENERGY SOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) the total power generation capacity
added through various non-conventional
energy sources in the year 2000-2001;
(b) the share of wind, solar and tidal
power in the total power generated through
these sources;
(c) what are the various incentives given
to private power producers in setting up non-
conventional energy power projects; and
(d) the amount sanctioned and spent in
this regard?
Revision in the order of Warrant of
Precedence
*451. SHRI BHAGATRAM
MANHAR: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is considering
a revision in the order of Warrant of
Precedence; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Construction of roads under PMGSY
in Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh and
Madhya Pradesh
*452. MISS MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) the allocation for Jharkhand,
Chhattisgarh and Madhya Pradesh under
Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojna
(PMGSY) scheme for the last two years;
(b) how much money was actually
released under the above allocation;
(c) how many roads in kms. were
sanctioned against above allocation;
(d) what has been the expenditure so far
against the amount released; and
(e) how many sanctioned roads have
since been started/completed and are in
progress?
Shortage of Coal during Tenth Plan
*453. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of COAL AND
MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether in view of the Tenth Plan
Draft the coal demand of the country in
2006-2007 is projected at 511 million
tonnes;
(b) if so, whether there will be shortage
of coal as per this report;
(c) whether the private investment will
become inevitable; and
(d) if so, whether Government have
taken any step in this regard, if so, the details
thereof?

137
WIN2\SESSION\237RS 137
Central assistance to Andhra Pradesh
for old age pension
*454. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in Andhra
Pradesh old age pension under Central
Pension Scheme is being paid as Central
assistance only and the State is not
contributing anything towards this, whereas
most of other States are contributing and
paying old age pension at higher rates;
(b) if so, the details thereof and reasons
cited by State Government in doing so; and
(c) whether Government propose to
increase Central assistance to the State so as
to enhance old age pension?
Formula for power allocation from
Central Power Stations
*455. SHRI AIMADUDDIN AHMED
KHAN (DURRU): Will the Minister of
POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government of Rajasthan
has been demanding review of the allocation
formula for power allocation from Central
Power Stations;
(b) if so, how far the power requirement
of the State falls short under the present
formula;
(c) on what lines the formula is sought
to be reviewed; and
(d) the Government's response thereto?
Probe into Godhra incident
*456. SHRI AMAR SINGH: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government of Gujarat has
set up an inquiry to probe the Godhra
incident which had resulted in killing of
hundreds of innocent persons in Gujarat;
(b) if so, the details thereof including the
name of the Judge who would head that
Inquiry Committee; and
(c) what are the terms of reference of the
said Committee and by when its report is
likely to be received?
Statutory Development Board for
Konkan
*457. SHRI SATISH PRADHAN: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that State
Government of Maharashtra is requesting
his Ministry from time to time for the
establishment of separate Statutory
Development Board for Konkan;
(b) if so, Union Government's response
thereto and the steps taken in this regard;
and
(c) the reasons for the delay?
Security infrastructure in ordnance
depots
†*458. DR. A.K. PATEL: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a lack
of security infrastructure in ordnance depots
in India;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether Government propose to
formulate any scheme for modernisation of
security infrastructure of these ordnance
depots?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

WIN2\SESSION\237RS 138
Proposal to run the Dabhol Power
Plant by NTPC
*459. SHRI V.V. RAGHAVAN:
SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the National Thermal Power
Corporation (NTPC) is considering a
proposal to run the Dabhol Power Plant;
and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Financial status of State Electricity
Boards
*460. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased to
state:
(a) what is the latest financial status of
each State Electricity Board as on 31st
December, 2001;
(b) how much money is due to the State
Electricity Boards payable by the respective
State Government/Union Territory; and
(c) how Government propose to help
them?

Liberalisation of coal policy
3234. SHRI RUMANDLA RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH: Will the Minister of
COAL AND MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Union Government has
liberalised its coal policy and has given new
guidelines recently;
(b) if so, whether under this policy and
guidelines, the State Government companies
can now mine for coal and lignite through
memorandum of article of association;
(c) whether any restriction have been
imposed on the companies in this regard;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) to what extent the State Government
have welcomed this move?
Primary Aluminium metal production
by recycling the scrap
3235. SHRI B. J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of COAL AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) what is the percentage of primary
Aluminium metal production made by
recycling the scrap in the year 2000-2001;
(b) how it compares with World figures;
and
(c) how much Aluminium scrap was
imported during last three years and how
the use of imported scrap compares with
the domestic scrap in respect of Aluminium
metal production through recycling process?
Shovel destroyed in Jayant Project
†3236. SHRI MUNAVVAR HASAN:
Will the Minister of COAL AND MINES
be pleased to refer to reply given to Unstarred
Question 3053 on the 19th December, 2001
in Rajya Sabha and state:
(a) what action has been taken against
then Chief General Manager and Additional
General Manager (Mines) for the  damage
to the machine;
(b) the total amount spent by the Jayant
Project for repairing of machine;
(c) whether it is a fact that completely
damaged Shovel was not removed for three
days;
(d) whether it is also a fact that as per
the report of Security Committee of the
Jayant Project, the Shovel was completely
destroyed and was not workable for months;
and
(e) the month-wise working hours, after
the three days of accident, alongwith the
total production made by the machine, till
date?

705
WIN2\SESSION\238RS 705
Disinvestment from the Jabalpur GCF
and vehicle factory
†3237. SHRI P. K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
disinvest from the vehicle factory and gun
carriage factory at Jabalpur;
(b) if so, the norms fixed for the same;
and
(c) whether disinvestment will effect the
secrecy of defence production of the
country?
Increase in China's defence budget
3238. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR
REDDY:
SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item "China's
Defence Budget Worries Experts" appearing
in the Times of India dated 7th March, 2002;
(b) if so, Government's reaction thereto;
and
(c) the steps proposed to be taken to

correlation in India's defence budgetary
exercise?
Joint naval exercise by India and
Singapore
3239. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a 10 days joint
exercise by the Indian and Republic of
Singapore Navy was conducted recently at
Kochi coast; and
(b) if so, how far it has been successful?
Project sanctioned for development of
landmines
†3240. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government had sanctioned
four projects, between 1984 and 1992, for
construction and development of landmines;
(b) if so, the details of the progress made
so far in these projects; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
provide these mines, having the capability
of 20 kilometer range, to Indian Navy?
Making India self-reliant in defence
spares
3241. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) the progress made by India in
indigenously manufacturing spares for
defence equipments;
(b) what is the percentage of indigenous
supplies both from Government and private
sectors compared to the percentage of
components imported; and
(c) the details of efforts being made to
maximize the supply of spares and
equipment from within the country itself?
Foreign Direct Investment in Defence
Sector
3242. SHRI CHO S. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) the impact of the recent opening of
defence sector for foreign direct investment;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

(b) whether Government has received
any proposals in this sector;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the number of proposals cleared so
far?
Advertisement for various post in
DRDO
3243. SHRI DILIP SINGH JUDEV:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that an
advertisement (No. 58) for various posts in
the Defence Research and Development
Organisation  was issued on 19.2.2001 and
interview was held in September, 2001;
(b) if so, whether it is a fact that the
persons who cleared the interview for
Electrical Engineering were not absorbed,
but, another advertisement (No. 59) was
issued in October, 2001 for almost identical
posts; and
(c) if so, the reasons for issuing the
second advertisement in such a quick
succession and whether Government
propose to take steps to first absorb all the
persons who cleared interview against the
first advertisement?
Encroachment of Secunderabad
Cantonment land
3244. DR. C. NARAYANA REDDY:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that some land of
the Secunderabad Cantonment is subject to
encroachment;
(b) if so, what action has been taken to
reclaim the land; and
(c)  what special measures are being
taken to ensure security of the Defence Zone
in view of the growing residential colonies
in the surroundings?
Development of troops in border areas
3245. SHRI NILOTPAL BASU: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have decided not to withdraw the
deployment of our armed forces from the
border areas;
(b) if so, till now many days this
deployment has been on till date; and
(c)  the average daily additional
expenditure incurred for effecting/retaining
this deployment?
Tracing 54 POWs in Pakistani Jails
3246. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have been approached by the kith and kin of
POWs to appoint an independent
investigative agency to trace 54 POWs, who
had been held captive in Pakistani jails since
1971 war;
(b) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto; and
(c)  what constructive steps are being
taken to trace them?
Takeover of immigration check-posts
3247. SHRI RUMANDLA RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH: Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Union Government has
decided to takeover all immigration check-
posts from the States in a phased manner;

707

†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, whether the Union Government
had taken this decision following a review
of security measures after the attack on
Parliament House;
(c)  whether there are 60 such check-
posts in the country, of them 19 are at the
airports, 30 road check-posts are on the
border towns and 16 at the ports; and
(d) if so, by what time final decision for
takingover the immigration check-posts will
be taken?
Condition of Roads in Delhi
3248. SHRI BHAGATRAM
MANHAR:
SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that bad roads is
the single biggest reasons for the loss of
crores of rupees each day because of higher
cost of vehicle maintenance and fuel
consumption;
(b)  if so, what steps Government is
contemplating to lay good roads throughout
the National Capital Territory of Delhi in
the near future; and
(c)  whether Delhi Police will identify
bad roads in NCT and take appropriate steps
for laying of these road for proper and
smooth traffic flow and if not, the reasons
therefor?
Paramilitary forces deployed for
Manipur Assembly Elections
3249. SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
SHRI SURESH KALMADI:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of paramilitary forces
deployed in Manipur for the conduct of
Assembly elections;
(b)  whether the provided number met
the number of such forces demanded by the
State's administration; and
(c)  if adequate number of paramilitary
forces were not provided, the reasons
therefor?
Proposal to ban Hindu fundamentalist
organisations
†3250. SHRI JANESHWAR
MISHRA: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to ban
Hindu fundamentalist organisations which
are posing danger to the sovereignty of the
country;
(b)  if so, by when alongwith the details
thereof;
(c)  whether Government will take action
against the people who are responsible for
causing death to many persons in riots in
various parts of the country, particularly in
Ayodhya and Gujarat and the situation
arising as a result thereof; and
(d) if so, the details of the action taken
against them?
Steps taken to deal with the threat of
terrorist organisation
3251. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government’s attention has
been drawn to the news captioned ‘Wake
up call from Lashkar Boss’ which was
published in The Indian Express on 31st
March, 2002;

708

(b) if so, Government's reaction thereto;
and
(c)  the details of steps being taken to
deal with such threats and to check their evil
motives?
S.M. service to collecting information
regarding stolen vehicles and passports
†3252. SHRI BACHANI LEKHRAJ:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Delhi Police
has achieved a roaring success in collecting
information with regard to theft of vehicles
and passports, after initiating S.M. service;
(b)  if so, whether Government propose
to initiate this service in other parts of the
country also; and
(c)  if so, by when alongwith places
where this service would be initiated and if
not, the reasons therefor?
Paramilitary personnel joining militant
organisations
3253. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether a number of cases involving
paramilitary personnel deserting their force
and joining militants have come to notice;
(b)  if so, the number of such cases
detected and involved persons arrested
during the last one year; and
(c)  the other details in this regard?
Hike in the Centre's contribution for
modernisation of police in States
3254. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Centre has hiked its
contribution for police modernization in the
States;
(b)  if so, what was the amount of
contribution of the Centre during the last
three years, year-wise;
(c)  whether States have utilized this
amount; and
(d) the States which have used it properly
and the States which have not used it
properly?
Infiltration of Bangladeshis posing as
pilgrims
3255. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the news-item captioned 'Posing as pilgrims,
Bangladeshis sneak into India' which
appeared in The Hindustan Times on
11th March, 2002;
(b) whether it is true that a large number
of Bangladeshis sneak in West Garo Hills
districts of Meghalaya and Assam as
pilgrims though the area is well protected
by the BSF jawans; and
(c)  if so, what vigorous steps are being
taken by Government to check infiltration
of Bangladeshis?
Madarsas funded through hawala
†3256. SHRIMATI JAMANA DEVI
BARUPAL: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that many madarsas are getting
money through hawala;
(b) whether it is a fact that Government
of Rajasthan has sent a list of such madarsas
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

to Central Government which are suspected
of taking money through hawala and
propagating fanaticism on being would over
communally sensitive retinitis on bordering
areas;
(c)  if so, whether it is also a fact that
citizenship of teachers of arabic allegedly
teaching in madarsas is also being
questioned; and
(d) if so, action taken by Government in
this regard alongwith the details thereof?
Arms   and   ammunition   brought   to
Delhi by terrorists through fruit trucks
†3257. SHRI DEVI PRASAD
SINGH: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that terrorists
accompanying the trucks bringing fruits
from Kashmir are succeeding in delivering
arms and ammunition in the national capital;
(b) the number of incidents/cases came
to the notice of Delhi Police after the terrorist
attack on the Parliament;
(c) whether it is also a fact that owners/
drivers/cleaners of the trucks either due to
the threat of terrorists or having sympathy
towards them are enhancing the contacts

Delhi and its surrounding areas; and
(d) if so, the Government’s reaction
thereto?
Indiscriminate border fencing along
North 24 Pargana district of
West Bengal
3258. SHRI YADLAPATI VENKAT
RAO: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that indiscriminate
border fencing along Bangladesh border in
North 24 Pargana district of West Bengal is
being done;
(b) if so, whether Government have
received reports in this regard;
(c) whether as a result of this fencing
thousands of people from Bongoan and
Badga would be shifted to Bangladesh; and
(d) if so, the corrective steps taken by
Government in this regard?
Pakistan based militants killed near
Katra, Jammu
3259. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether five Pakistan based militants
were killed by security forces just 15
kilometre from Katra base town for shrine
of renowned Vaishno Devi in Jammu and
Kashmir in March, 2002;
(b) whether Government has
strengthened the security in this region
because lakhs of pilgrims visit Vaishno  Devi
every day; and
(c)  if so, the details in this regard?
Mechanism to monitor use of Hindi
3260. SHRI RAJNATH SINGH
'SURYA': Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any mechanism for
monitoring use of Hindi by different
Ministries/Departments;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it has been noticed that there
is little or no use of Hindi by our delegations
on official occasions abroad or within the
country; and
(d) if so, the steps taken to increase the
use of Hindi?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

710
WIN2\SESSION\238RS 710
Sophisticated weapons sought by West
Bengal
3261. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the State Government of
West Bengal has sought sophisticated
weapons from centre after the terrorist attack
on American Centre in Kolkata;
(b) if so, whether Central Government
has supplied these weapons as per demand
of the State Government; and
(c)  if not, the reasons thereof?
NLFT camps in Bangladesh
3262. SHRI NARENDRA MOHAN:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that National
Liberation Front of Tripura (NLFT),
